thread:
Ava - CSM: Quick sync on Kestrel private/VPC deploy — found a few items blocking smoke tests. Summarizing: firewall NAT rules, KMS key policy cross-account, and audit-forwarder not receiving events. Need owners and ETA.
Liam - Solutions Eng: Thanks. Can you paste the exact firewall error from the node logs?
Ava - CSM: Node log snippet: `2026-03-20T10:12:03Z ERROR: connect timeout 10.2.3.1:4500` — happens when pod tries to reach the audit-forwarder ELB.
Noah - Infra Eng: Looks like SNAT is dropping return traffic. Customer transit gateway only allows 443/80 outbound. We need ephemeral ports open or SNAT from a NAT gateway owned by their infra account. Can they add rule to allow 1024-65535 outbound to our forwarder IPs?
Marta - Customer Ops: Kestrel (customer) is ok with a change window Friday 2000-2300 PT. They asked if we can do a brief test before cutover.
Liam - Solutions Eng: If we open ephemeral ports, we'll validate with a quick curl from a test pod: `curl -v https://audit-forwarder.example.net/health` — please let me know when rule is in place.
Priya - Security Eng: On KMS: current key policy denies cross-account Decrypt for our service role. We need `kms:GenerateDataKey` + `kms:Decrypt` allowed for `arn:aws:iam::REDFWN:role/redwood-service-role`. Suggest temporary scoped allow limited to the onboarding key alias.
Ava - CSM: Customer said they want least-privilege. Can we provide the minimal policy snippet they can paste?
Priya - Security Eng: Paste below — they can restrict by `Condition` later but this will unblock tests:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "OnboardAllow",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDFWN:role/redwood-service-role"},
      "Action": ["kms:GenerateDataKey", "kms:Decrypt"],
      "Resource": "*"
    }
  ]
}
```
Liam - Solutions Eng: Note: after policy change we should validate by running `kms:GenerateDataKey` from our role in staging. I can run that once Priya confirms.
Noah - Infra Eng: Audit-forwarder not receiving logs — looks like TLS handshake failures from our side when connecting into customer ELB. I captured the TLS error on the router: `tls: handshake failure: remote error: tls: bad certificate`
Marta - Customer Ops: Customer confirms the ELB is using a wildcard cert for `*.kestrel-corp.com` — they will share the cert chain and the CA details in the secure drop.
Ava - CSM: Action owners so we don't lose track:
- Noah: network/SNAT rule verification + ephemeral port check (ETA Fri 18:00 PT)
- Priya: prepare minimal KMS policy snippet and post final wording (ETA today EOD)
- Liam: validate KMS call and health endpoint after infra changes (ETA Fri night during window)
- Marta: collect cert chain from Kestrel and confirm change window (ongoing)
Liam - Solutions Eng: Also flagging a follow-up for post-go-live: enable prefix/KV caching for their high-throughput routes — will cut token costs. Not a blocker but good to note for renewal health.
Marta - Customer Ops: Customer asked about renewal implications — if we hit go-live this week they’ll be comfortable keeping committed capacity; if delayed >2 weeks they re-evaluate level. Marking as moderate renewal risk until we close blockers.
Ava - CSM: Noted. I'll update the customer healthboard and add this thread to the onboarding ticket. Any blocking questions?
onboard-bot: Checklist update: added items — `network_rules`, `kms_policy`, `audit_cert` to ticket KEST-ONB-412. See /runbook/privatelan-onboard for steps.
Priya - Security Eng: One more nit: ask the customer to rotate the KMS key ARN after we validate and then provide us the new alias — we can re-lock permissions to role-only. Minimizes long-term blast radius.
Noah - Infra Eng: Confirmed. I'll retry TLS handshake test after they drop cert chain. If handshake still fails we may need their ELB to accept TLSv1.2+ with modern ciphers (list provided in DM).
Ava - CSM: Great. I'll capture the feedback points for internal retro: (1) earlier KMS policy guidance in the runbook, (2) add SNAT guidance to the quickstart, (3) audit-forwarder cert checklist.
Marta - Customer Ops: Captured. Closing loop: customer expects final test results by Sat 0300 PT. I'll nudge them if we miss Fri window. :thumbsup:
Liam - Solutions Eng: Thanks team — ping me here when infra changes are live and I'll run the health checks.
Ava - CSM: Thanks all, will update thread as things change.
